_doc: A11 balance overlay on the DESIGN.md §9 tables, found with tools/sim_zones.js on the game engine. check_mons.js --write applies it; check_mons.js verifies src/data == DESIGN ⊕ this file. monsters.<id>.s: sim_zones --fit (every species' pure group worth 3.2 standard monsters over the tiers where '@' picks it, lvOff 0/1 → HP lost 9.2%, 2.8 rounds) then --refit (zone groups vs a strength-proportional target); per lineage and stat all stages move one way (§9.13.1). encounters.<zone>.groups: --retilt re-weights each 'dyn' zone's T0/T1 groups (tier-only copies) toward its T2–T7 HP lost (M2), plus earlier hand fixes. monsters.<id>.desc and actions.<id>.<name|msg>: STYLE_JA fixes. Every entry carries a why.
